title: One minus shift is monic on the sequential coproduct
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $E:\mathbf N\to\operatorname{Comp}(\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O))$ a sequential system of cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Put $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}E_n$ and let $\iota_n:E_n\to A$ be the coproduct injections. The morphism $u:A\to A$ determined by $u\iota_n=\iota_n-\iota_{n+1}E(n\leq n+1)$ is a monomorphism. No injectivity of the transition morphisms is assumed.

source.place: Tag 093W (lemma-colim-sequence), proof by finite initial-sum short exact sequences; used in Tag 0949 (lemma-colim-hocolim)

proof.text: For a sequential system E in a preadditive category, define q_j from its coproduct to E_j by the transition E_k → E_j on k ≤ j and zero on k > j. The k-th component of one minus shift followed by q_j is the identity for k = j and zero otherwise, by functoriality when k < j. For each finite set S of indices, the finite sum of q_j followed by the j-th inclusion into the finite subcoproduct is an explicit retraction of the restriction of one minus shift. This includes the empty set. The restrictions form a natural transformation from Mathlib's liftToFinsetObj finite-subcoproduct diagram to the constant coproduct diagram.

Use the already proved source theorem SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian for the underlying sheaf of rings directly; the separate localized-generator theorem is not used. Shrink AB5 to universe zero using AB5OfSize_of_univLE. Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.GrothendieckAbelian supplies exact filtered colimits for complexes by degreewise evaluation. The finite-subcoproduct cocone is a colimit by CoproductsFromFiniteFiltered.isColimitFiniteSubproductsCocone, and a filtered constant cocone is a colimit by isColimitConstCocone. Apply NatTrans.mono_of_mono_app to the split monic finite restrictions and colim.map_mono' to these two colimit cocones, obtaining precisely the displayed Sigma.desc morphism.

theorem telescopeShift_mono
    {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (E : ℕ ⥤ CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ) :
    Mono (Sigma.desc (fun n : ℕ ↦
      Sigma.ι (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj n) n -
        E.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)) ≫
          Sigma.ι (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj n) (n + 1)))
